name: Warp Pressure
summary: A Psyker has a score called Warp Pressure. Warp Pressure starts at 0. Whenever you use a psychic power, increase your Warp Pressure by that power’s cost. After resolving the power, roll a d20. If the result is equal to or lower than your current Warp Pressure, Perils of the Warp triggers. Example: ● Your Warp Pressure is 5. ● You cast Focused Rupture. ● Focused Rupture adds +2 Warp Pressure. ● Your Warp Pressure is now 7. ● You roll a d20. ● On a 1- 7, Perils trigger.
